dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You're here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Columbina... you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Mm, and now you're here too. So I suppose we're here together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You say that as if you knew I'd come.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I didn't know when, but I knew you'd come eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Just as there is always a pull between the moon and Teyvat. You always find your way to me, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Come, sit with me for a while. I saved you a seat.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Last time we sat on your ship, we were looking at Teyvat. Let's look at the stars this time.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Ninnin and those who came before her were drawn to those stars. There must be a different kind of gravity there. I can feel it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ninnin and the message she sent...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Don't worry. She's not in danger.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She traveled very, very far in safety — so far that I can no longer sense the power I used to guide her on her way.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But... I'm curious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About what?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: All kinds of things. For instance... Would a message from a Moongazer ever be received by someone else?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Whoever receives it — or whatever else may receive it... who might they be?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What would they think? Would they know love and hatred just like us?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Would they still be drawn to the beautiful yet mysterious sky above, even with the abyss closing in around them, just like us?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Would they, like us, also want to find others, wave at them, and say, "Hello, friend. I'm happy to meet you"?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Out there, in the depths of this starry sky... Are there still civilizations untouched by the darkness?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think there are.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Our ship once received a message.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What kind of message?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Almost all of its meaningful content was lost.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But it must have come from an intelligent civilization.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Lost... Was it because it had traveled too far...?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Still, even this much is encouraging enough.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Your birthplace... It's out there too, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If one day, you decide to return to where your journey began, to clean it up...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I'd be glad to lend a hand. Just like how you helped me clean the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then I won't forget to invite you.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: And another party?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And another party.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Then...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What do you think of calling it "Home-Returning Night"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if it's during the day?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Then we'll celebrate all day until night falls. We can invite all our good friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like it's gonna be very fun.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: May that night arrive beneath clear skies... with friends reunited.
